name: gmdtool Runtime Bridge
description: Opt-in localhost runtime bridge, Item tracing and probes, verified GitHub updater, and experimental background focus-loss recovery.

enabled.name: Enable local API (restart required)
enabled.description: Start a 127.0.0.1 server on port 18731 for Python gmdtool.

auto-update.name: Check for updates automatically
auto-update.description: Checks once on main-menu entry and on Geode mod-item/mod-popup activity. No periodic idle checks; use the main-menu Updates button at any time.

allow-background-play.name: Allow background level play (experimental)
allow-background-play.description: EXPERIMENTAL: With authenticated background_control, bypass unfocus pause and attempt one safe Cocos Director resume only if gameplay was running when focus was lost. Does not force minimized frames; may conflict with pause mods. Default off.
